name: 7 Forges Tools Catalog
description: Complete catalog of 1450+ interactive HTML tools organized across the 7 Forges framework. Auto-generated from repository root HTML files and mapped to forges by keyword analysis. Primary LLM entry point for tool discovery and developer onboarding.
purpose: Enable developers, LLMs, and autonomous agents to discover, index, and launch any of the 1450+ tools in the platform. Each tool is pre-categorized into one of 7 Forges based on its function domain. Supports rapid project bootstrapping for contributors.
inputs: Repository root HTML files (auto-scanned by scripts/sync-forges.js)
Developer invocation via dev-launch.html or DEV_LAUNCH_GUIDE.md
outputs: tools-catalog.json — machine-readable tool registry for all 7 Forges (tool count reflects last sync)

keyFiles.role: Complete tool registry: 1449 tools mapped to 7 Forges with title, description, and URL
Compact LLM context file for AI-assisted development and tool discovery
Visual developer hub — forge-organized tool browser with search and launch
Step-by-step developer onboarding and sync guide
Sync script — regenerates tools-catalog.json and validates JSON integrity
Forge metadata: chakras, frequencies, archetypes, domains for all 7 Forges
7 Forges web entry point — central navigation hub
